title: Step data for net1 on the concepts of BBRv3's width 7 seed 128
description: Step 4 retrains net1 on the concepts of the seed search's hit, BBRv3's width 7 seed 128 with the window hidden (release exp-controller-seed-search-49, decompose-ctl-bbr3-k7-s128/decompose.json, the latents' own axes): its five recovered formulas, written in experiments/specs/concepts-s128.json as net1's LCFs. They read features over the steps before each step (a mean over 240 ms, a mean and a maximum over 960 ms), which a table keeping every 6th step cannot compute, so campaign run --features computes them over every step of each episode and keeps them beside the strided steps. The data is net1 v5's training set (examples/net1_broad.py, set train30: 2,400 links, two conditions each from a broad set of 64, three controllers per link, 30 s episodes, every 6th step kept), as experiments/data-net1-broad-30s.json made it in the project compact was forked from, with the fixed rule from exp-steps-behaviour-rule-8. An episode that fails validation is recorded as failed and left out of the data. At most five cells run at once, beside the seed search's five.
prepare: uv run python examples/net1_broad.py "$OUT/spec-train30" --set train30 --models "$IN/rule/models"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-train30/campaign.json" "$OUT/campaign-train30"
run: mapfile -t F < <(jq -r '.lcfs[]' experiments/specs/concepts-s128.json); uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/campaign-train30" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps --steps-stride 6 --features "${F[@]}" || echo "an episode failed; it is recorded as failed and left out of the data"
collect: echo '| set | status |' > "$OUT/summary.md"; echo '|---|---|' >> "$OUT/summary.md"; uv run expliccit campaign status "$OUT/campaign-train30" > "$OUT/status-train30.json"; echo "| train30 | $(jq -c . "$OUT/status-train30.json") |" >> "$OUT/summary.md"
